intro.h2: A tile contractor in Ruidoso who finishes the whole room
paragraphs: Elevated Services LLC is a tile contractor in Ruidoso that also takes care of the pieces around the tile: vanities, light fixtures, medicine cabinets and new floors. One cabin owner had Jeremy update her kitchen and bathroom and wrote that he went over and above everything she asked.

Other reviews tell the same story in different words. A homeowner whose vinyl plank floor cracked from a problem under the surface had it repaired and called the result beautiful. Another client has hired the company for several projects and says Jeremy is there when he says he will be. If a bathroom, shower or floor needs work, call and talk it through.

items.name: Bathroom updates
items.blurb: A bathroom refresh can mean more than new tile. In one cabin bathroom Jeremy put in new floors, a new vanity with a tiled wall behind it, a medicine cabinet and new light fixtures, all listed by the owner in her Google review.

items.name: Tile showers and walls
items.blurb: Tile is the main trade on the Elevated Services Google listing. One finished bathroom shows a walk-in shower in large marble-look wall tile with a mosaic niche, a small hexagon tile floor, a black-framed glass door and matching black fixtures.

image.alt: Walk-in tile shower with marble-look tile, mosaic niche, hexagon floor tile and black-framed glass door

items.name: Flooring installs and repairs
items.blurb: Wood, vinyl and laminate flooring are on the Elevated Services Facebook page. When one homeowner's vinyl plank floor cracked because of an issue underneath, the damaged planks came up, the subfloor was patched and new planks went down the hallway.

image.alt: Hallway with new light oak vinyl plank flooring after a repair

why_choose_us.h2: Why Ruidoso homeowners call Elevated Services

items.title: He shows up when he says he will
items.text: A repeat client wrote that Jeremy is always extremely reliable and fair, and that he turns up on the day he promises. For a bathroom you use every day, that matters.

items.title: Clients come back
items.text: One client has used Jeremy and Elevated Services for several different projects and says they have learned to count on him to do fantastic work.

items.title: More than the list
items.text: A cabin owner called Jeremy a true craftsman who wants everything done correctly, and said he went over and above all she asked on her kitchen and bathroom update.

items.title: Fixes the cause, not just the look
items.text: When a vinyl plank floor cracked because of a problem below it, the repair photos show the old planks pulled and the subfloor patched before new planks went in.

about.text: Ask a client of Elevated Services LLC who did the work and you will hear one name: Jeremy. He is the person reviewers hired, the one on the job and the one they call back for the next project. One cabin owner described him as trustworthy, hard working and a true craftsman. The business is based in Ruidoso, and its Facebook page lists more than finish work: tile, wood, vinyl and laminate flooring and stacked stone veneer, plus dirt work, skid steer services, driveway grading and yard cleaning. It has 5.0 stars from 9 Google reviews.

process.h2: How a job with Elevated Services works

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Call (575) 937-3752 Monday to Friday between 8 AM and 5 PM, or email a few photos of the room or floor.

steps.title: Talk through the job
steps.text: Explain what you want changed, from a cracked plank floor to a full bathroom update, and ask what the work involves.

steps.title: Choose materials
steps.text: Settle on tile, flooring, vanity, fixtures and finishes together before work starts, so you know exactly what is going in.

steps.title: The work
steps.text: Jeremy and Elevated Services do the work. Reviewers describe a craftsman who wants everything done correctly and keeps to the schedule he sets.

steps.title: Walkthrough
steps.text: Look over the finished room together and point out anything you would like adjusted before the job is closed out.

service_area.text: Elevated Services LLC is based in Ruidoso. The Google listing does not show a street address or a mapped service area, so the quickest way to find out whether your home is in range is to call (575) 937-3752 or email elevatedtile575@gmail.com with your town and a short description of the job. Reviews include a cabin kitchen and bathroom update and repeat projects for the same client.

items.q: What kind of work does Elevated Services do?
items.a: The Facebook page lists tile, wood, vinyl and laminate flooring and stacked stone veneer, along with dirt work, skid steer services, driveway grading and yard cleaning. Google reviews describe kitchen and bathroom updates at a cabin and a vinyl plank floor repair.

Google lists Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (575) 937-3752 during those hours to reach Jeremy, or email elevatedtile575@gmail.com any time with a few photos of the job and your town.

items.q: Can you fix a vinyl plank floor that has cracked?
items.a: Yes. One homeowner hired Elevated Services to fix LVP flooring that had cracked because of a sub surface issue and said they did a beautiful job. Photos from that job show the damaged planks removed and the subfloor patched before new planks went in.

Call or email to describe the job and ask how pricing works for it. Estimate terms, including whether there is a charge, are not listed on the Google or Facebook pages, so it is worth asking when you first get in touch.

Elevated Services is based in Ruidoso. There is no public street address on Google, which is common for contractors who work at the client's home. Call (575) 937-3752 with your town and the team can tell you whether the job is in range.
